title: Fix test - wait for other threads before throwing the exception

timeline.message: Fix test - wait for other threads before throwing the exception
timeline.author: Stanislav Malyshev

timeline.body: Maybe we could make this slightly simpler by using a n`AtomicReference<CountDownLatch>` and then doing something like  `latch =  getAndSet(null); if (latch != null) latch.await` to save a variable?

reply.body: Not sure I understood how it should work. I think it's better to check if this one works and then if it fixes the issues then we can refactor it.

timeline.body: Looks good, what do you think about my suggestion though to simplify this slightly?  :)
